name: Baz
description: Baz MCP connects your coding agent directly to Baz's indexed repositories and review platform. Search code, files, and architecture across repos without manually crawling the codebase; fetch your org's actual code review guidelines and reviewer configs to check changes against real standards; pull open review discussions for a branch; and push or update session plans back to Baz so your team can collaborate on and review them in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Baz to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Baz to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://baz.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Baz MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baz provides these MCP tools: get_review_discussions, load_resources, organizational_review_guidelines, remote_file_search, remote_grep, repo_search, and update_plan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Baz?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Baz in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Baz requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Baz is developed by Baz Technologies Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
